name: com.google.android.ads.mediationtestsuite.activities.ConfigurationItemDetailActivity
description: Google Mobile Ads Mediation Test Suite opens this screen for a selected configured item. It lists that item's mediation sources and can load test ads from sources selected by the developer.
disableEffect: Developers can no longer review that item's mediation sources or run batch test-ad requests; regular ad delivery is unaffected.
